resolution.note: biome ignores test/fixtures/gh as one glob; rule test red on base, green now

title: Verbatim receiver captures are never rewritten by the formatter
body:
Retro of #1376: npm run fast (biome --write) reformatted a new verbatim gh capture under test/fixtures/gh, so its provenance sha256 broke and fast failed after 395s. Each capture is excluded one by one in biome.json.
Outcome: every file listed in a test/fixtures/*/provenance.json is outside biome's includes (one directory glob), and a rule test fails when a provenance-listed capture is formatted by biome.
Proof: node --test test/rules/capture-bytes.test.ts: exit 0
Files: biome.json, test/rules/capture-bytes.test.ts
